notes: Client fix for 1.3.7.3. The dev panel Patreon buttons threw ReferenceError: _godTok is not defined. The new code was appended to the END of god-panel.js, outside the IIFE that opens at line 2 and closes at line 856, while _godTok is declared INSIDE it. An inner declaration is not visible to an outer reference, so every button failed on click. node --check passes on this because it is a SCOPE error, not a SYNTAX error, and nothing in the build validates scope. The block now lives inside the IIFE alongside every other god function. Running the repo's own tools/scopecheck.py then found the same shape in galaxy.js: the warehouse helpers had been appended after the last IIFE closed. That one was a false positive, a top level function declaration hoists to global and an inner reference resolves fine, confirmed with a repro, but the helpers were moved inside the calling IIFE anyway so the checker stays quiet and a real hit next time is not lost in noise. First relocation attempt targeted the LAST close in the file rather than the one that ends the calling IIFE, which would have genuinely broken renderWarehousePanel, gToast and renderMarketsTab; the checker caught that too. Also removes an em dash from dev panel output. CLIENT ONLY, no restart, hard refresh required.
